evidence.title: GitHub - paper-design/shaders: Zero-dependency canvas shaders that can be installed from npm or designed in Paper

name: Paper Shaders
summary: Ultra-fast zero-dependency shader library for React and GLSL: animated backgrounds, image filters and logo effects.
description: A shader library used as React components or raw GLSL: mesh gradients, dithering, god rays, liquid metal, halftone, noise and more, grouped as image filters, logo animations and effects. Each shader is a parameterized component (colors, speed, scale, fit, pixel ratio) documented on its own page and installed from npm.
contains: shaders in three groups: image filters, logo animations and effects
image filters: paper texture, fluted glass, water, image dithering, halftone dots, halftone cmyk, lens distortion
logo animations: heatmap, liquid metal, gem smoke
effects: mesh gradient, dithering, grain gradient, dot grid, warp, spiral, swirl, waves, voronoi, metaballs, god rays
every shader is a parameterized component: colors, speed, frame, scale, rotation, fit, pixel ratio
install: npm i @paper-design/shaders-react for React, @paper-design/shaders for vanilla, or copy the GLSL
each shader has a live page documenting every parameter with ranges and enum values
